notes.title: Stream Slugger Version 1.1.7
notes.notes:
🎉 Stream Slugger v1.1.7: Twitch Connection Issue Fixed! 🎉
Hi Everyone,

We’re excited to announce that Stream Slugger v1.1.7 is now available, and the Twitch connection issue from version 1.1.6 has been resolved!

What’s New in v1.1.7:
🛠️ Fixed: Twitch connection bug that occurred when reconnecting after a previous day.
🌟 Improved stability and performance.
Next Steps:
Update to Stream Slugger v1.1.7.
Enjoy seamless Twitch connections and all the features Stream Slugger has to offer!
Thank you for your patience and support while we worked on this fix.

Kind regards,
Phil

notes.title: Stream Slugger Version 1.1.6
notes.notes:
Stream Slugger + Twitch Integration

We’re excited to announce that OAuth 2.0 integration is now live, connecting Stream Slugger directly to Twitch! 🎉

This update enhances security and streamlines the connection process.
No more generating tokens manually via Twitchapps.Tmi—it's now seamless and automated.
With this foundation in place, we’re ready to start building even more features for Stream Slugger.

Thank you for your support, and as always, Happy Sluggering!
